==Notes==
*Make sure the target has a [[cover]] enchantment, since a well-placed [[List of enchantment removal skills|enchantment removal]] from a [[foe]] will cause your party member to die.
*Dying while enchanted by this skill does not count as a [[death]]; teams on [[Kill Count]] and [[Alliance Battle]] maps will not be awarded points for deaths of players under the effects of Unyielding Aura.
